55)༄༅/yang zab dkon mchog spyi 'dus kyi dbang bskur ji ltar bya ba'i las rim lo rgyus rnam bshad dang bcas pa sgrigs chags ltas chog tu bkod pa bzhugs

tei:div.tei:p: 55) ༄༅/ yang zab dkon mchog spyi 'dus kyi dbang bskur ji ltar bya ba'i las rim lo rgyus rnam bshad dang bcas pa sgrigs chags ltas chog tu bkod pa bzhugs so/ 56) dkyil 'khor ma lus pa'i spyi dpal khyab bdag padma 'od 'bar sprul 'khor bcas pa'i zhabs kyi padmor phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o/ byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ 'dir mtshungs bral rig 'dzin chen po 'ja' tshon snying po'i gter chos yang zab dkon mchog spyi 'dus kyi dbang bskur ji ltar bya thabs mdo tsam ston te/ de nyid kyi dkyil 'khor dang bcas dbang rdzas sogs yo byad thams cad tshang bar bshams dgos te/ de yang gsang sngags zab mo'i dbang bskur gyi rigs 'di dag la g.yas med khyad sod sgyid ngan gron chung stabs bde'i dbang du mi btang bar phyi nang gi rdzas dang yo byad bshams dgos lag len ting 'dzin sogs gzhung ltar bgyis na legs tshogs kyi yon tan dang byin rlabs shugs kyi 'byung*/ 57) de ltar ma yin par sla chos dang bzo lum ras chos byas na sngags kyi dam dang 'gal zhing rten 'brel gyi gnas chugs te bar chad kyi rgyu rkyen du 'gyur bas/ des na dkyil 'khor dang gtor tshogs mchod sogs rgyas par 'dzoms ngos/ cho ga gzhung srang la bdag bskyed dang bcas pa dang*/ mdun bskyed kyi dkyil 'khor dbang rdzas rnams kyi skyed chog rab gnas byin rlabs rnams kyang nan tan du byas la/ bzlas pa'i 'dzab bsnyen ci mang dang*/ tha mar stong phrag las mi nyung bar bzla zhing slob dpon rang nyid ting nge 'dzin gyi dbang blang ba sogs sngon du bya ba'i las rim rnams mtha' dag zin par bya'o/ ༈ de nas slob ma rnams tshogs re bar chad kyi bgegs sbyang phyir glud gtor/ nyams chags kyi sdig sgrib sbyong ba'i khrus 58) chog bsod nams kyi tshogs bsags phyir maṇḍal sogs spyi ltar byas pa'i rjes su zab mos chos bzhin 'chad de/

nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad myur du bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya ba'i phyir du dam pa'i chos gsan zhing smin byed kyi dbang bskur zab mo zhu bar 'gyid snyam pa'i thugs bskyed rin po che mdzad nas gsan 'tshal/ de yang lung las/ sangs rgyas 'byung ba brgya la rnyed mi 'gyur zhes pa ltar yin pa la/ da res dal 'byor phun tshogs kyi mi lus thob cing rgyal ba'i bstan pa dang mjal nas dam pa'i lha chos la spyod du yod pa'i dus 'dir/ nam bzhag gtan gyi 'dun ma thar ba'i lam sna zin pa'i thabs 'bad dgos/ de ltar ma byas 59) na tshe'i nyi ma ni yun thung*/ 'chi bdag gi bdag po ni dbang mgyogs/ 'chi ba'i rkyen ngan ni grangs mang*/ mtshor yengs ma lam gyi ngang nas 'chi ba nam mkha'i thog ltar 'ong bas/ de la 'bros pa dang gzur ba'i thabs ni gang yang med/ shi ba tsam du ma zad khams gsum ris drug 'khor ba sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtsho gang du skyes kyang bde ba'i go skabs spu tsam med par sdug bsngal gyi yo lang 'ba' zhig la spyod dgos pas bzod thabs mi 'byung*/ de lta bu las skyob cing thar ba'i thabs ni dam pa'i chos gcig pu las gzhan gang gis kyang mi phan pas/ des na da lta dbang po tshang zhing rang dbang rang la yod pa'i dal 'byor don med stong zad du mi bya bar 'chi khar 'gyod med grabs la rems dgos/ dam pa'i chos kyi rnam grangs dang 60) theg pa'i bye brag lam gyi 'jug sgo ni mtha' yas pa shig mchis mod kyang*/ kun gyi snying po don gyi mthar thug ni theg chen gsang sngags rdo rje'i theg pa kho na yin te/ de la brten par tshe gcig byang chub 'grub pa'i thabs ma mchis pa dang*/ theg pa gzhan rnams ni lam gyi gzhi'am lam stegs kyi tshul tsam yin la gsang sngags ni lam dngos dang 'bras bu nyid la sbyor bar byed pa dang*/ gzhan rnams ni brjod byed kyi tshig gtso bor ston la/

gsang sngags ni brjod bya'i don nyid gtso bor ston pa dang*/ gzhan rnams ni dper na 'o ma lta bu yin la/ gsang sngags ni mar gyi yang zhun lta bu yin pa sogs kyi khyad chos mang po dang ldan zhing*/ gsang sngags de lta bu'i 'jug sgo ni smin byed dbang dang grol byed kyi gdams pa gnyis yin pa las thog mar smin byed kyi dbang thob dgos shing*/ de nyid thob par 61) byed pa'i bdag po'i rkyen ni rdo rje'i slob dpon la rag las pa dang*/ rgyu'i rkyen du slob ma rnams dag snang mos gus dang ldan pa/ dmigs pa'i rkyen du dbang rdzas yo byad tshogs pa/ de ma thag pa'i rkyen du dkyil 'khor bsgrub mchod bzlas pa la sogs sngon du bya ba'i las rim rnams legs par grub pa nas/ dngos gzhi dbang bskur la'ang thog mar brgyud pa'i khungs btsun zhing gdams pa la yid ches nges shes bskyed phyir bla ma brgyud pa'i lo rgyus brda tsam zhig snyan snyan du 'bul bar 'gyid na/ spyir phyogs dus kyi sangs rgyas thams cad ston pa sku gsum gyi ngo bor ma 'dus pa med pa/ sku gsum po yang bla ma rdo rje slob dpon mchog gi ngo bo nyid du dbyer med pa ni/ bskal pa stong gi sangs rgyas kyang*/ bla ma dag la brten nas byung*// zhes pa ltar dang*/ de lta bu'i bla ma'am slob dpon de dag la zer snyam na thams cad dang bral 62) ba'i yon tan thams cad tshang zhing rdzogs pa'i rdo rje'i slob dpon yang dag pa ni gu ru gu ru padma 'byung gnas yin te/ ji skad du/ rang byung padma zhes byar grags pa gang*// sangs rgyas snang ba mtha' yas thugs las sprul// 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang gsung gi 'od// mkha' 'gro yongs kyi ming po dpa' bo'i rgyal// dus gsum rgyal ba kun gyi phrin las bdag /mnyam med kun bzang rdo rje 'chang chen po// sprul pa'i skur snang thugs rje'i stobs chen ldan// gang la gang 'dul phrin las rlabs po che// sems can rnams kyi re 'dod yid bzhin skongs// zhes gsungs pa bzhin te/

gu ru padma 'byung gnas de nyid 'khor 'das thams cad kyi sngon rol nas 'khrul med rang rig gdod ma'i ka dag klong yang chen por sangs rgyas pa'i mtshan gyi rnam grangs su chos sku kun bzang 'od mi 'gyur ba'am drug pa rdo rje 'chang chen po dang*/ sangs rgyas snang ba mtha' yas ces bya ba ste/ 'khor 'das dus gsum mnyam nyid ye shes chen po 63) spros bral 'dus ma byas pa'i chos sku mchog gi ngo bor rtag tu bzhugs pa yin la/ de nyid kyi rang mdangs 'gags med kyi 'od gsal lhun grub zung 'jug bde ba chen po'i rol pa longs sku'i dkyil 'khor du snang ba ni dpag tu med de/ dbus tshogs bde chen snying po bkod pa'i rgyan zhes bya ba'i zhing khams su slob dpon padma rnam par snang mdzad gangs chen mtsho zhes bya ba'i sku'i ba spu'i khung bu re re nas yang gangs chen mtsho'i longs spyod rdzogs sku'i zhing khams bye ba phrag brgya dang*/ de dag re re'-i ba spu'i khung bu re las sprul pa sku'i zhing khams bye ba phrag brgya brgyar gang la gang 'dul gyi 'gro ba'i don mdzad pa dang*/ de bzhin du shar phyogs bde chen rnam bkod kyi zhing khams su padma 'byung gnas rdo rje gangs chen mtsho'i sku'i bu ga re re la de dang mtshungs pa'i longs sprul gyi zhing khams bye ba phrag 64) brgya gcig la gcig 'phel dang*/ lho phyogs su bde chen rin chen bkod pa'i zhing khams na padma 'byung gnas rin chen gangs chen mtsho bye ba phrag brgya brgya 'gyur ba gong bzhin dang*/ nub phyogs padma bkod pa'i rgyan du slob dpon padma gangs chen mtsho bye ba phrag brgya 'gyur sngar bzhin dang*/ byang phyogs bde chen las rab bkod par padma 'byung gnas phrin las gangs chen mtsho bye ba phrag brgya gong 'phel 'gyur gyi zhing khams phun sum tshogs pa'i bkod pas 'gro don mdzad pa'i longs sku'i dkyil 'khor de dag re re'i ba spu'i grangs rnyed bye ba phrag brgya'i sprul sku'i zhing dang gang 'dul sprul pa'i zlos gar bsgyur tshul dus gsum rgyun chad med pa'i tshad tshadabazung bar ni su yi nus la/

'o skol gyi mi mjed 'jig rten khams 'di gcig pur yang zhing dang ston par sprul pa'i mdzad phrin ni dpag tu med de/ shākya'i dbang po'i bstan 65) pa 'di la slob dpon padma 'byung gnas sprul pa'i gu ru mtshan brgyad sogs su sprul nas rdo rje theg pa'i bstan pa rgyas par mdzad pa 'di bzhin du/ 'di nas shar shar phyogs su zhing khams dri ma med pa ces bya bar sangs rgyas dri med rnga sgra'i bstan pa la slob dpon padma dri med skye bzang du sprul nas 'gro don mdzad pa dang*/ lho phyogs yon tan 'byung ba'i zhing du gu ru padma lhun grub 'od kyi 'khor lo dang*/ nub phyogs ye shes rgya mtsho'i zhing du sna tshogs par padma gar gyi dbang phyug dang*/ byang phyogs 'jigs bral gyi zhing na padma ye grub mtha' bral dang*/ de bzhin du phyogs dang phyogs bral gyi zhing sna tshogs par padma 'byung gnas/ smra ba'i se ge bzhad pa'i rtsal 'chang*/ thugs rje 'gro 'dul/ 'jig rten dbang phyug 'khor ba dong sprugs/ rang byung ye shes/ bde ba'i gtsug phud/ chos dbyings dpal 'bar/ gser gyi ri dbang*/ rgyal ba'i 66) me long*/ snang ba'i cod pan/ rnam dag ye shes/ 'khor ba'i gcong 'byin/ laṃ ster bshes gnyen/ 'dod dgu 'byung gnas/ bde ba sbyin mdzad/ mi nub rgyal mtshan/ 'khor ba yongs 'dul/ rol pa rnam dag ces bya ba la sogs pa'i mtshan gyi rnam grangs brjod las 'das par bzhugs pa dang*/ stong gsum 'jig rten 'di nyid kho na'i bye brag 'gro ba ris drug gi gnas ris tha dad du yang 'dul byed sprul pa'i gu ru drug tu sprul ba de dag re re las kyang sprul pa du mar 'gyed pa ste/ lha rnams 'dul ba la gu ru srid thub 'dzin dang*/ de'i rnam 'phrul ni chos kyi 'byung gnas/ rig pa'i 'byung gnas/

dga' ba'i 'byung gnas/ chags mchog 'byung gnas/ yaun tan 'byung gnas/ shes rab 'byung gnas/ ye shes 'byung gnas/ dri med 'byung gnas la sogs kyi mtshan 'chang bas lha rnams kyi 'pho ltung gi sdug bsngal sel zhing brtson 'grus kyi chos ston pa dang*/ de bzhin du lha min 67) rnams la gu ru rnam par rgyal ba'i skur sprul zhing*/ de las kyang dharma thod phreng*/ saṃ bha wa thod phreng*/ nir ma ṇa thod phreng sogs dang*/ badzra ratna padma karma buddha thod phreng rnams su sprul nas lha min 'thab rtsod kyi sdug bsngal sel zhing*/ byams dang snying rje bzod pa sogs kyi chos ston/ mi'i gnas su gu ru padma 'byung gnas las sprul pa'i gu ru mtshan brgyad yang sprul nyi shu rtsa gcig sogs su sprul bas gdul bya so so'i skal ba dang dbang po'i rim pa tha dad dang mthun pa'i chos ston/ byol song rnams la gu ru seng ge rab brtan dang*/ de las sprul pa'i rnam grangs bde ba'i 'byung gnas/ dag pa'i 'byung gnas/ shin tu dag 'byung*/ gter gyi 'byung gnas/ byang chub 'byung gnas dbang gi 'byung gnas/ phrin las 'byung gnas la sogs kyis dud 'gro'i bkol spyod kyi sdug bsngal sel zhing shes rab dang rten 'brel gyi chos 68) rnams rang rang gi brda dang skad kyis ston cing 'dul bar mdzad/ yi dwags rnams la gu ru rnam par snang byed dang*/ de'i yang sprul bde ba'i dbang po/ shānta rakaṣi/ gshor ba gzhon nu/ pu ni tra/ padma badzra/ puṇḍa rī ka/ padma bhu ti la sogs pas yi dwags bkres skom gyi sdug bsngal sel zhing sbyin pa dang smon lam gyi chos ston/ dmyal ba pa rnams la gu ru rnam par gnon pa drag po'i gzugs can dang*/ de las sprul pa bde mchog snying po/ bde ba'i dngos grub/ nag po spyod pa/ gzi brjid 'od 'bar/ padma kun rgyu/ padma mkha' ldingal sogs pas dmyal ba tsha grang gi sdug bsngal sel zhing bsam gtan ting nge 'dzin gyi chos ston par mdzad pa sogs 'gro don gyi sprul pa'i sgyu 'phrul ni rang cag so so skye bo rnams kyi blo'i spyod yul las 'das pa lags shing*/

da lta rnga yab gling du srin po'i kha gnon la bzhugs tshul gcig 69) pu'i sku'i bkod pa'i rnam 'gyur kyang tshad med de/ srin po'i rgyal khams yul gling chen po nyi shu rtsa gnyis yod pa'i dbus na sha khrag za byed kyi gling du grong khyer bye ba phrag dgu'i rgyal po bdud bdul he ru ka zhes bya bar sprul nas gsang sngags sbyor grol mngon byung gi chos kyis 'gro ba'i don mdzad pa dang*/ de bzhin du shar stod dzā ti'i nags gling na grong khyer 'bum tsho nyer gcig gi rgyal por padma de wa rā dzā zhe bya bar sprul nas zhi khro sgyu 'phrul gyi chos ston pa dang*/ shar smad na bun thib pa'i gling ba grong khyer bye ba phrag gsum la rgyal po smra ba'i seng ges 'jam dpal sku'i chos kyis 'dul bar mdzad pa dang*/ lho phyogs keng rus brtsegs pa gling na grong khyer bye ba bcu drug gi rgyal po kā la thod phreng zhes bya bas ma gshin phur pa drag po'i chos kyis 'dul ba dang*/ nub stod sha mkhar 70) can gyi gling na grong khyer 'bum phrag nyer dgu'i rgyal po khyung chen 'bar ba zhes pas nges don phyag rgya chen po'i chos kyis 'dul ba dang*/ nub smad khrag mtsho khol ba'i gling na grong khyer bye ba gnyis yod pa'i rgyal po gtum po me dbal zhes bya bas 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyi chos skor kho nas 'dul ba dang*/ byang phyogs 'dod 'byung nor bu'i gling gi grong khyer bye ba phrag gcig la rgyal po badzra pā ṇi zhes bya bas drag sngags mngon spyod kyi sgo nas 'dul ba dang*/ shar lho 'bar ba glog phreng gi gling na grong khyer 'bum phrag bcu gnyis kyi rgyal po zil gnon me 'od ces bya bas ma mo rgyad lung gi chos kyi 'dul/ lho nub raksha 'khrug pa'i gling na grong khyer 'bum phrag drug gi rgyal po raksha thod phreng gi gsang sngags dus 'khor gyi chos ston/

nub byang rlung nag 'khrug pa'i gling gi grong khyer 'bum mtsho 71) gsum na rgyal po la seng ge sgrar sprul bas 'jig rten mchod bstod kyi chos ston/ byang shar mun nag 'khrig pa'i gling na grong khyer 'bum phrag nyer gcig gi lam rgyal po gtsug na me 'bar gyis dmod pa drag sngags rol pa'i chos kyis 'dul bar mdzad la/ khyad par dbus zangs mdog dpal ri'i rtse mor padma 'od kyi pho brang chen po'i yang thog na gu ru thod phreng rig lnga*/ bar khang na mtshan brgyad rig 'dzin 'bum gyis bskor ba 'og khang du drag po thod phreng rtsal la mkha' 'gro chos skyong bka' gnyan bla ma rgya mtshos bskor nas bzhugs te bla med 'bras bu rdzogs chen gyi chos 'khor rgyun mi chad par mdzad pa dang*/ pho brang gi phyi rol tu yang shar zhi ba chos kyi tshogs khang ba slob dpon nyid paṇḍi ta'i cha byad kyis bka' sde snod gsum gyi chos 'khor bskor/ lho phyogs rgyas pa longs spyod kyi tshogs khang du gu ru nyid tshe dpag med kyi skur bzhengs nas gsang sngags rgyud sde rgya mtsho'i smin grol gyi chos 'khor bskor/ nub smad dbang gi tshogs khang du slob dpon nyid rta mgrin dbang gi rgyal por bzhengs te ma rgyud thabs lam zab mo'i chos skor gsungs byang drag po phrin las kyi tshogs khang du gu ru drag po gtum chen du sprul nas sde brgyad dregs pa 'dul byed phrin las rab 'byams kyi chos 'khor bskor bar mdzad pa sogs ngo mtshar gyi rnam par thar pa ni bskal ba brgyar yang brjod kyi mi langs shing*/ sku dngos de lta bu'i tshul las ma g.yos par bzhugs bzhin du/ gdul bya'i zhing khams nam mkhas gar khyab thugs rje'i sprul pas khyab cing*/ khyad par 'o skol tha 'khob bod kyi yul du dus bzang tshes bcu'i mchod pa dang gsang sngags zab mo'i dbang bskur ye shes 'bebs pa'i skabs rnams dang*/

73) gzhan yang dad pas gsol ba gang 'debs kyi sar thugs rje'i sgyu 'phrul nam mkha'i glog las myur bas gshegs nas byin gyis rlobs par zhal gyis bzhes thugs dam du bcas pa lags te/ nyid kyi bka' las kyang*/ dad gus mos gdung can gyi skye 'gro la/ sangs rgyas gzhan las bdag nyid thugs rje myur/ khams gsum 'khor ba'i sems can ma zad par/ padma 'byung gnas thugs rje zad mi srid// ces gsungs pa bzhin/ ma 'ongs pa na rgyal ba byams pa'i bstan pa shar tshe// slob dpon nyid rgyal sras 'gro ba kun 'dul zhes par sprul nas gsang sngags theg chen bla med kyi chos ston gsungs pa bzhin du/ mdor bsdu na/ de lta bu'i thugs rje phrin las rmad du byung zhing sku che ba'i yon tan 74) mtshungs pa bral ba'i rgyal ba padma 'byung gnas de nyid rgya gar 'phags pa'i yul du mi lo sum stong drug brgya'i bar du bstan pa'i sgron me sbar zhing sems can gyi don mdzad pa'i mthar/ gangs can bod kyi yul 'dir 'jam dbyangs sprul pa'i rgyal po khri srong lde btsan gyi spyan drangs nas/ lha ma srin gdug pa can rnams dbang du bsdus shing dam la btags te bka'i bsrung mar bskos/ bsam yas mi 'gyur lhun gyis grub pa'i gtso byas pa'i mtha' 'dul yang 'dul gyi gtsug lag khang grangs med bzhengs shing rab tu gnas par mdzad/ lo paṇa mkhas grub mang por bcas pas bka' mdo rgyud lung man ngag gi chos kyi gter mdzod cig bshad sgrub thos bsam sgom pa'i dge 'dun gyi sde gtsug ste sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan phyogs bcur 'jug pa'i bka' drin gyis 75) khyab par mdzad pa'i skabs der/ grub thob rje 'bangs nyer lnga dang skal ldan snying gi bu dgu la sogs la gsang sngags theg pa'i yang snying zab pa'i mthar thug tshe gcig lus gcig la rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bde slag tu thob par byed pa'i chos bka' rab 'byams mtha' yas pa'i char rgyun phabs nas/

dus ma 'ongs snyigs ma rtsod ldan gyi gdul bya rnams la brtse ba chen pos dgongs te rgyud lung man ngag bskyed rdzogs smin grol las tshogs dang bcas pa'i chos skor zab cing rgya che ba yid bzhin gyi nor bu dbang gi rgyal po las lhag pa'o dngos grub kyi 'dod 'jo ma gyur pa rnams yi ger btab nas gnas chen ri brag gnyan khrod gtsug lag la sogs pa ji snyed khyab pa gter du sbas pa dag rje 'bangs skal ldan skyes mchog de rnams 76) kyi smon lam thugs rje'i rnam 'phrul rim can du byon pas gter nas ston te las 'phro skal bar ldan pa'i gdul bya rnams smin grol du mdzad pa las/ da lam gyi chos bka' 'di nyid kyi dbang du bgyid na/ gu ru rin po che'i zhal slob lhag med 'od lus 'grub pa'i grub thob brgyad kyi nang nas ting 'dzin zag med 'od gsal chen por dbang bsgyur ba myang ban ting 'dzin bzang po zhes/ sngon tshe thub pa'i drung na dge slong gau'u ta ma gsang bdag phyag rdor gyi spyan sngar lha'i sngar lha'i rig 'dzin grags ldan mchog skyong*/ bod tha 'khob kyi rgyal po la snga ba 'od gsal lha'i rigs 'chang gnya' khri btsan po la sogs dag pa'i skyong ba brgyud mar byon pa'i myang ban chen po de nyid la chos bka' 'di dag gi dbang bsgyur/ bka' gtad/ lung bstan/ byin gyis 77) brlabs/ smon lam gyis mtshams sbyar te/ ding sang 'o skol dus ngan gyi 'gro ba sdug bsngal sna tshogs kyis nyam thag pa 'dul zhing skyobs pa'i rnam 'dren dam par bsngags par mdzad cing chos bka' rnams rgya rim pa bdun gyis btab nas kong yul nyang lung wa ra ṇa tshal gyi gter gnas haṃ 'phrang lcags kyi sgo mor gter du gtams nas bzhugs su gsol/ de nas gu ru'i thugs rje dang sngon gyi smon lam gyi mthu las myang ban de nyid sku lus zad med du thim kyang thugs rje ye shesarnam rol gyi sgyu 'phrul las/

snyigs ma'i dus su 'gro ba'i don du sprul pa'i skyes sgom pa'i ye shes rdo rje/ 'gro mgon dung mtsho ras pa/ mkhas grub chos dbyings dbang phyug gam 'khrul zhig bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ grub thob sangs rgyas sgom pa 78) ras dkar thugs rje rgyal mtshan/ dung mtsho ras pa phyi ma/ sprul sku bsod nams rgyal po/ drung pa chos bzang nyi ma/ rab 'byams/ grub mchog sbyin pa larin chen la sogs pa skyes chen du mar sprul nas yul dus de dang de bya rnam grangs te/ slar lnga brgya tha ma rtsub 'gyur rab 'khrug pa'i dus 'dir gter ston gyi o rgyan las 'phro gling pa rnam grangs su 'ja' tshon snying po/ khrag 'thung hūm̐ nag me 'bar la sogs par grags pa'i snyan pa'i rgya mtsho par byon pa de nyid sku gzhon nu'i dus nas skyes bu dam pa'i rnam thar gyi mtshan nyid yongs su tshang zhing*/ skye don mthar phyin kyang gdul bya rnams la gdams ngag rnam thar gyi sgo nas ston pyir bstan pa larin po che'i sgor zhug 79) man ngag gi gsan bsam phyogs med du sgro 'dogs bcad/ dka' dpyad snying rus kyi go cha rmad du byung bas bsgrub pa brtse gcig gis rang don mngon du gyur/ zab mo'i gter sgo phyes shing gzhan don du thugs bskyed smon lam las 'phro'i 'bras bu smin pa'i mkhyen brtse nus pa'i phrin las zla med pas skal ldan gdul bya'i kha lo thar gling du bsgyur ba'i 'dren mchog ded dpon dam pa de nyid kyis gter nas spyan drangs pa'i bka' drin las byung ba'i zab chos 'di dag mtshan ldan bla ma brgyud pa'i byin rlabs kyi drod ma yal/ dam tshig gi sel ma zhugs/ snyan rgyud kyi zam ma chad/ dngos grub kyi mtsho ma skam/ phyag bzhes kyi gnas ma chugs/ gu ru padma 'byung gnas nas drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma'i bar du smin grol

80) gyi chu rgyun ma chad pa'i babs tshul de ltar lags pas na/ thugs dad pa mos gus kyi snang ba gong 'phel du mdzad par 'tshal zhing*/ 'di lta bu'i dbang bskur zab mo gsan par byed pa la dang por lha dang bla ma dbyer med la gsol ba gdab pa 'di'i rjes zlos gnang bka' drin skyong bar zhu/ dkon mchog spyi 'dus bla ma ni// rigs rnams kun bdag che ba'i mchog dpa' bo chen pos rjes bzung*// dbang gi smin grol dngos grub stsol// de ltar gsol ba gdab pa'i sngon du song nas slob dpon gyi gnang ba'i skabs phyes pa yin pas/ des na gsang sngags zab mo'i chos ni dper na seng ge'i 'o ma ltar yin phyir snod kyi mtshan nyid tshul bzhin ldan pa ma gtogs/ snod ma yin pa'i lam du song na nyes ltung chen po'i phung bar 81) 'gyur bas/ gsang ba'i dam tshig las mi 'da' bar mdzad dgos pa lags/ de ltar yin na he ru ka'i// dal dus su zhugs smin par bya/ bla med yang gsang byin rlabs 'di// gnas khang 'di yi phyi rol du// dam med pa la smrar mi rung*/ de phyir snying nas bro bor zhig badzra rakaṣa si hūṃḥs ma ya i dan na ra kan/ ces pas/ dam tshig gi rdo rje spyi bor bzhag cing bdud rtsi lce la bzhag go ༈ de nas ye shes dbab pa'i phyir du spos dang rol mo sogs tha mal 'khrul zhen gyi snang ba bsgyur ba'i rdzas dang yo byad rnams gsar la/ de nas yang khyod rnams thugs ma yengs par gsan mdzod/ gsang sngags snying po'i don gyi dbang zhu bar byed pa la bdag gzhan snod bcud rnams tha mal 'khrul 'dzin a 'thas kyi blo ngor dbang bskur ba'i yul min te/ de lta bu la 82) bskur yang mi chags pa'i phyir snod bcud lha'i dkyil 'khor ye nas yin kyang yin tshul ngo ma shes pa'i gang zag ngo sprod cing gsal gdab pa dang*/ de las mi 'gyur bar dam tshig ye shes dbyer med du rgyas btab dgos pa ni dbang don gyi gtso bo yin phyir des na dmigs pa 'di bzhin bsgom par zhu/

'o skol rnams kyi 'dug pa'i gnas khang yul khams 'di thams cad tha mal gyi yul ma yin par ye shes 'od lnga las grub pa'i zhing khams gzhal yas khang du mos pa mdzad pa dang*/ bdag slob dpon yang tha mal rang rgyud pa la ma yin par gu ru padma 'byung gnas kyi rnam rol du nges shes bskyed pa gnang*/ khyod rang rnams kyang skad cig dran rdzogs su gdan padma nyi zla brtsegs pa'i khar sku'i ngo bo rje btsun chen po rgyal ba padma 'od 'bar du lam gyis gsal te/ sku gzi brjid kyi lhun 83) po mtshan dpe'i dpal du 'bar ba thabs shes kyi phyag gnyis snang stong zung 'jug mtshon phyir g.yas gser gyi rdo rje dang*/ g.yon mtshan thod pa tshe bum gyis mtshan pa bsnams shing*/ bde stong mnyam nyid mtshon pa'i kha ṭwam̐ mchan khung g.yon du 'dzin pa/ sku lnga yongs rdzogs kyi dbu zhwa 'dab ldan rigs lnga nyi zla rgod dar dpyang dang ldan pa dbu la gsol bas khams gsum zil gyis gnon pa sku la theg pa rim dgu'i zab ber/ mdo sngags zung 'jug gi chos gos/ yon tan yongs rdzogs kyi rgyan chas rnams kyi spras pas srid gsum dbang du bsdud pa/ srid zhi dang rtag chad kyi mtha' dang bral bas zhabs rdo rje skyil krung gis zhugs pa/

ye shes lnga rdzogs 'ja' 'od 'khyil ba'i klong na snang stong zung 'jug gi skur gsal zhing*/ snang grags thams cad rigs 'dus bla ma'i 84) dkyil 'khor ye gdod ma nas yin pa la yin pa'i nges shes brtan po mdzad 'tshal zhing*/ de nas bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo'i thugs srog gi 'od zer dang*/ khyed rang rnams kyi spyi bo mgrin pa snying ga gsum du om̐ ā hūm̐ gis mtshan pa las kyang 'od zair kha dog sna tshogs 'phros pas/ lho nub padmo da kyi gzhal yas su rje btsun chen po padma 'byung gnas sprul 'khor dang bcas pa rnams la phog pas thugs dam gyi rgyud bskul nas/ nam mkha'i khams thams cad bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro'i lha tshogs kha ba bu yug 'tshubs pa ltar byon te snang srid thams cad rol mo'i sgra dang spos dris gang zhing thugs rje byin rlabs kyi rdzu 'phrul rlabs chen g.yo bas khyed rang rnams kyi lus ngag yid gsum la dbyer med du thim pa'i mos pa drag po rtse gtsig tu mdzad par zhu/ ces dmigs pa sprad cing spyan 'dren 'dzab dbyangs rol mo sogs kyi rten 'brel rgyu rkyen 'dzoms pas snang ba zi bun gyi 'gro thub par bya zhing*/ me tog la rten 'brel snying po gu ru bzlas pas char ba phab cing dam ye gnyis med brtan par bya'o/ ༈ de nas dbang dngos gzhi bskur ba'i rim pa la/ dbang don sems la sprad pa/ dbang rdzas lus la bzhag pa/ dbang tshig rna bar grags pa dang bcas pa 'dzoms dgos pas na/ dbang don gyi dmigs pa'i brda don 'di bzhin thugs dgongs 'tshal te/ spyir dbang gi rnam grangs la bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig mchis mod kyang mdor bsdu na/ lus ngag yid gsum shes bya'i sgrib pa dang bzhi po dag par byed cing 'bras bu sku bzhi 'grub pa'i slad du bum gsang sher ye tshig dbang dang bzhi la brten nas lam smin grol skal ba rgyud la 'jog pa yin pas/ thog mar lus smin par byed

86) pa bum pa'i dbang bskur ba lags te/ des na dbang bskur ba'i slob dpon dang bskur ba'i yul khyod rang rnams dang bcas pa thams cad rgyal ba padma 'od 'bar gyi ngo bor gsal bar mdzad pa'i ngang nas/ bskur byī dbang rdzas 'di dag rnams kyang gnas skabs su mtshon byed kyi dpe dang brda tsam yin la don dam par rgyal ba 'od 'bar gyi sku nyid yin par gsal ba'i gnas gsum 'bru gsum las 'od zer 'phros pa khyod rang rnams kyi spyi bo mgrin pa snying kha rnams la rim bzhin thim pa'i dmigs pa ma yengs par gnang ba zhu/ ༈ hrīḥ dkon mchog spyi 'dus rigs kyi bdag dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// sku gsung thugs mchog rin po che// byin larlabs klongs yangs rin chen 'bar// om̐/ sku yi smin mtshams om̐ dkar las// 'od zer skar mda' 'chad pa ltar// skal ldan lus la gnyis 87) med thim// bum dbang thob nas snang stong bsgom// padma 'byung gnas sku yi dbang thob shog om̐ āḥhūm̐ badzra gu ru padma siddhi/ kā ya a bhi ṣīhūm̐ oṃ/ zhes 'dzab dbyangs rol mor bcas pas bum dbang spyi bor bskur ba'i rjes la ngo sprad pa ni/ ༈ de ltar bum pa'i dbang bskur ba'i lus kyi sgrib pa ma lus pa byang nas/ lus lha'i ngo bar rgyas thebs pas snod bcud lha'i bskyed rim bsgom pa'i skal ba dang ldan zhing*/ bla ma sprul ba sku'i go 'phang thob pa'i rten 'brel gyi nus pa rgyud la bzhag pa yin pas de lta bu'i nges shes mdzad pa dang*/ dbang 'di'i dam tshig tu lus kyi mi ladage ba spong zhing lha dang bla ma'i bskyed rim bsgom pa la rgyun du brtson par mdzad dgos pa lags/ hrīḥ dkon mchod spyi 'dus rigs kyi bdag gsung gi ljags steng āḥdamar las// 'od zer dmar mo'i rtse 88) mo ltar/ skal ldan lce la gnyis med thim// gsang ba'i dbang thob ngag rlung bsgom// padma 'byung gnas gsung gi dbang thob shog

badzra gu ru = wā ka a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ ces thod pa bdud rtsi mgrin par bskur nas/ de ltar gsang dbang ngag la bskur nas ngag gi sgo nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib dag cing ngag sngags kyi 'khor lor rgyas thebs pa/ bsnyen sgrub bzlas dang rtsa rlung bsgom pa'i skal bar ldan la/ mthar thug bla ma longs sku 'grub pa'i rten 'brel rgyud la bzhag pa yin la/ dbang 'di'i dam tshig tu ngag gi mi dge ba spong zhing rtag tu gsol 'debs bzlas pa la 'bad par gnang 'tshal/ hrīḥ dkon mchog spyi 'dus rigs kyi bdag thugs kyi hūm̐ sngon 'od 'bar las// 'od zer spos reng du ba ltar// skal ldan sems la gnyis med thim// shes ye'i dbang thob gsal stong sgom// padma 'byung gnas thugs kyi dbang thob shog 89) badzra gu ru = tsitta a bhi ṣīñtsa hūm̐/ ces phyag mtshan kha ṭwām̐ phyag rgya mtshon byed snying khar bskur la/ de ltar shes rab ye shes kyi dbang yid la bskur bas sems kyi sgrib pa sbyang*/ sems chos nyid kyi rol par rgyas thebs shing*/ spros med rdzogs rim bsgom pa'i skal bar ldan pa dang*/ mthar thug bla ma chos sku 'grub pa'i nus pa rgyud la bzhag pa lags shing*/ dbang 'di'i dam tshig tu yid kyi mi dge ba mtha' dag spong zhing rang rig bzo med lhug pa bcing grol bral ba'i nyams len las mi 'da' bar mdzad dgos pa lags/ de nas dbang rdzas bla mar gsal ba'i sku'i spyi mgrin snying kha lte ba gsang gnas lnga las 'od zer lnga 'phros pa khyed rang rnams kyi gnas lngar thim pas dbang bzhi yongs rdzogs thob pa'i mos pa gnang bar zhu/ hrīḥ dkon mchog sku gsung thugs yon tan// phrin las 90) 'dus pa'i 'od zer ni// nam mkha' chu la 'ja' shar ltar// skal ldan gnas lngar gnyis med thim// dbang bzhi ye shes rdzogs chen bsgom// padma 'byung gnas rang bzhin dbang bzhin shog /badzra gu ru = sarba dharma a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/

zhes pas stong pa mtshon byed du thod pa'i nang du snang ba mtshon phyir shel bcug la snang stong zung 'jug mtshon rdo rje dang lhan cig tu gnas lnga'am spyi bor bzhag 'di skabs su bla ma mtshan ldan gyi slob ma nyams len gcig dril byed pa'i rigs la ni gzhung nyid kyi gud du sbas pa'i tshig dang padma'i srog khur dang bcas pa'i ngo sprod tshul bzhin bya la/ gang zag phal pa rnams la ni yul ma yin pas gong gi brda mtshon 'di kas chog pa'o/ de ltar tshig dbang rin po che sgo gsum la dbang bskur bas/ shes bya'i bag chags phra mo yan chad sbyong ba dang*/ cir snang ye shes kyi rnam rol du rgyas thebs nas/ gnas lugs phyag rgya chen po'i 'od gsal rdzogs pa chen po bsgom pa'i skal ldan du gyur 91) nas/ myur ba nyid du bla ma sku gsum dbyer med ngo bo nyid mngon du gyur ba'i nus pa rgyud la bzhag pa lags shing*/ dbang 'di'i dam tshig tu sgo gsum chos min gyi bya ba ring du spang nas bskyed rdzogs zung 'jug sgom med yengs med khregs chod thod rgal gyi nyams len snying por dril ba la btson dgos pa lags tshe de bzhin dgongs par bcags 'tshal/ de nas gter chos kyi glegs bam dar sna lnga'i na bza' dril ba thogs la/ de lta bu'i dbang bzhi yongs su rdzogs thob pa'i mtha' rten zab chos bka' gtad rjes su gnang ba'i dbang 'bul ba yin te/ chos bka' 'di dag gi yig 'bru thams cad 'od zer kha dog lnga ldan gyi seng ge dbyangs gsal gyi rnam par khyed rang rnams kyi phung khams skye mched thams cad la thim byung ba'i mos pa mdzad par zhu/ hrīḥ sangs rgyas kun kyi ngo bo 92) pad 'byung gi zab gter thugs sgrub yid bzhin nor bu 'di// las can rnams la sgrub bshad bstan nas kyang*// ma 'ongs dam ldan 'gro kun grol bar shog ces lag tu gtad cing ā li ka li rten 'brel snying po bcas pa brjod/

de ltar bka' pu ti glegs bam gyi dbang bskur bas zab chos 'di dag gi tshig don la rang dbang thob cing rang gzhan gyi bsgrub pa la dbang ba'i skal ldan du byas pa yin la/ 'di'i dam tshig tu glegs bam dang mi 'bral zhing phyag mchod bkur bsti dang nyams len la brtson par mdzad dgos pa lags/ 'di skabs slob ma 'gro don nus pa'i rigs la chos kyi snyan grags dang gzhan don gyi rten 'brel du rgyal mtshan dang ba dan la sogs 'phyar zhing dung 'bud pa dang slob dpon rnams kyis bkra shis mnga' gsol rgyas par mdzad pa yang phyag bzhes so/ ༈ de nas slob ma snod ldan yin na bka' srung gi gtor ma tsag ga li dar mthing nag gi gur phub pa thog ste/ ༈ gtor ma 'di nyid kyang phyi 93) gtor ma'i rnam pa tsam la nang dur khrod 'jigs pa'i gzhal yas khang gi dbus su/ ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro seng ge'i gdong can 'khor mkha' 'gro chos skyong bka' srung gter bdag gi tshogs rngams brjid drag rtsal mthu stobs kyi gzi 'od me 'bar ba zhal mngon sum du khra lam me bzhugs pa 'di nyid kyi dbang bskur bas zhi rgyas dbang drag gi phrin las rab 'byams thogs med du 'grub pa'i nges shes mdzad par zhu/ hūm̐ bhyoḥ dus gsum rgyal ba'i yum gcig seng gdong ma// nam mkha'i mdog can 'od zer sprul pa 'gyed// mthong dang dran pa latsam gyis ye shes bskyed// skal ldan bu la lus dang grim pa'i tshul// mi 'bral byin rlabs phrin las dbang shog ḍākkī singha mu kha a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ gzhan yang phyi nang gi bka' srung thams cad kyis skal ldan 'di la bsrung ba 94) dang skyobs pa dang mdzad du gsol/ zhes gtor ma gnas gsum du bzhag cing*/ rkang gling sogs rol mo bsgrags/ me tog 'thor te/ de ltar dbang bskur bas mkha' 'gro chos skyong rnams lus dang grib ltar 'khor zhing ci bcol gyi las 'grub par 'gyur pa yin la/

chos skyong gnyer gtad kyi dbang 'di thob phyin chad bskyed rdzogs kyi nyams len brtson zhing srung ma rnams la bskang gso gtor mchod la 'bad pa dang*/ gtso bor dam tshig ma nyams pa gal che ste/ bsrung ma rnams ni dam tshig dang ldan pa'i gdong grogs byaid cing dam nyams rnams kyi srog gcod byed par rgyal ba'i spyan sngar dam bcas pa yin phyir/ 'o skol rnams dam tshig las 'gal na srung ma rnams bdud du bab par 'gyur la/ dam tshig gtsang ba phrin las ci 'dod yid bzhin du bsgrub par 'gyur 95) bas/ de lta bu'i spang blang gi gnad rnams go ba ma log par mdzad dgos pa dgongs par bcags pa zhu lags/ ༈ de nas bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro sangs rgyas byang sems sprul 'khor dang bcas pa mdun gyi nam mkhar byon nas me tog gi char 'bebs cing bkra shis kyi tshigs su labacad pa brjod nas rab tu gnas pa mdzad pa'i mos pa gnang bar zhu/ ces brjod la bkra shis brjod par bya'o/ ༈ 'di nyid kyi tshe dbang bskur ba'i rim pa ni/ de yang gang zag skal ba dang ldan pa'i rigasalalal chos bka' gtad pa sogs dbang lathams cad rdzogs par byed pa'i dbang du byas nas/ 'di nyid kyi dbang bzhi rnams tshul bzhin bskur nas/ pu ti lung ma bskur ba'i bar der tshe dbang bskur yang rung la/ yang na sgrub pa zhag grangs dang bstun nas tshe dbang rjes nas bskur ba sogs gang 'thad bya/ gzhan skye bo phal ba sogs 'di nyid dbang bzhi tshul ldan mi dgos pa'i rigs la tshe dbang rkyang pa bskur ba ni/ dbang rdzas yang 96) bum pa/ tshe chang gi thod pa/ tshe ril/ mda' dar rnams bshams pa ma gtogs gzhung gi dbang rdzas rnams mi dgos la/ tshe'i dbang rdzas dang gtor mchod bshams grub pa dang las gzhung bsrang zhing 'dzab kyi skabs su tshe 'dzab kho na bzlas par bya/ de nas dbang gral tshogs pa rnams la bgegs bskrad bsrung 'khor khrus chog sogs ni spyi dang mthun par rgyas bsdus gang 'os dang*/

chos bshad ni gong gi ye shes dbab pa yan chad mthar chags byas chog la/ ye shes dbab tshar rjes tshe'i dmigs pa 'di ltar sprad de/ shin tu bsdus pa la chos bshad 'di man chad kyi chog go ༈ de yang 'o skol 'gro ba sems can thams cad skyes pa'i mtha' ma de 'chi ba las ma 'das shing*/ gling gzhan gyi mi dang 'dod khams gzugs khams kyi lha la sogs la tshe tshad nges can du yod kyang*/ rang cag 'dzam gling brnams la ni tshe tshad nges pa med pa dang*/ so so la tshe'i dbang skal ji tsam yod pa de nyid kyang glo bur gyi skyen gyis bskyod pas/ tshe nyams pa 97) gud pa/ yar ba/ 'thor ba/ 'khyer ba la sogs pa'i dbang du song na dus min blo bur du 'chi bar 'gyur phyir/ tshe bsrings ba'i thabs gal che ba dang*/ de'i thabs kyi bye brag la bsam gyis mi khyab pa yod mod kyang mdor bsdu na rgyu rkyen gnyis la 'dus te/ rgyu ni skye 'gro gzhan gyi srog gcod spangs shing tshe thar srog bslu sogs dkar phyogs dge ba'i las la brtson dgos pa dang*/ rkyen gyi sgo nas tshe bsrings ba'i thabs ni lha dang bla ma'i byin rlabs la brten pa kho na thabs zab cing khyad par du gyur pa yin pa dang*/ de lta bu'i byin rlabs dang ldan pa ni chos sku snang ba mtha' yas/ longs sku latshe dpag med 98) pa/ sprul sku padma 'byung gnas rnams ngo bo gcig la rnam pa tha dad du bstan nas 'gro ba sems can las ngan 'chi rkyen drag pos gzir ba rnams sdug bsngal de las skyob pa'i thugs rje nus stobs dang ldan pa lags tshe/ des na skabs 'dir 'chi med tshe dbang bsgrub pa'i dkyil 'khor bdag mdun zung 'brel lha'i ngo bo tshe bdag padma 'byung gnas 'khor bcas rnams byin rlabs kyi sprin thibs/ dngos grub kyi mtsho 'khyil/ 'chi med tshe'i chu rgyun 'bebs cing bzhugs pa'i drung du dad pa dang lamos gus rtse gcig bskyed nas tshe dbang dngos grub zhu phyir gsol ba gdab pa 'di'i larjes zlos mdzad par zhu/

hrīḥ dus gsum sangs rgyas kun gyi ngo bo nyid// 'gro rnams ma lus sgrol ba'i ded dpon mchog u rgyan padma rig 'dzin tshe dpag med// bdag gi lus ngag yid gsum 99) byin rlobasal// 'chi med tshe'i dngos grub stsal du gsol// ༈ de ltar gsol ba btab pa la brten nas dkyil 'khor kun gtso tshe bdag padma 'byung gnas bdag mdun thams cad kyi thugs kha'i sa bon dang sku'i nas lnga nas 'od zer dpag tu med pa steng 'og phyogs mtshams 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad khyab par 'phros pas/ phyi 'byung ba sa chu me rlung nam mkha' la sogs snod kyi 'jig rten kun gyi mthu dang bcud kyi dngas ma thams cad dang*/ nang khams gsum gyi skye 'gro sems can mchog dman bar ma so so'i stobs rtsal nus pa ji snyed dang*/ gsang ba phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi bde bar gshegs pa sras 'khor sprul pa yang sprul dang bcas pa'i mkhyen brtse mdzad pa phrin las thugs rje byin rlabs yon tan mtha' yas pa'i bcud dang nus pa'i dngas ma sogs mdor na 'khor ba dang myang 'das kyis bsdus pa'i brtan g.yo'i 100) dngos grub tshe dpal longs spyod ci yod pa thams cad 'od zer yi ge nṛ yi rnam par bsdus te khyed rang rnams la thim pa'i mos pa ma yengs par mdzad par zhu/ hrīḥ phyi ni bum pa nang ni bdud rtsi gang*// ces pa nas/ 'od 'bar 'chi med tshe yi dbang thob shog om̐ āḥhūm̐ badzra gu ru padma siddhi a yu ṣe hūm̐ nṛ dzaḥ ces 'dzab dbyangs rol mor bcas te mda' dar g.yab cing tshe 'gug byas la/ mda' dar dpe dbang bskur ba yang gter ston nyid kyi phyag bzhes mdzad do/ ༈ de nas bum pas bskur ba dang*/ tshe chu sbyin pa/ tshe ril dang*/ tshe chang sbyin pa rnams ni gzhung tshig ji lta ba mthar chags byas la/ de nas rgyas gdab pa ni phyag bzhes su mar la 'bru gsum bzlas nas spyi bor g.yang mar gyi tshul du mdzad par snang zhing*/

gzhung nyid ltar na rdo rje rgya gram mam phyag na rdo rjes spyi bor rgyas gdab kyang rung zhing de'i brjod tshig ni/ om̐ āḥhūm̐/ dang po chos kyi dbyings kyi rgya// ces pa nas/ phyag rgya bdun gyi rgyas gdab bo/ badzra rakaṣa rakaṣa hūm̐/ de ltar dbang bskur zhing rgyas btab pas khyed rang rnams kyi lus ngag yid gsum ye shes rdo rje go khrab kyis rab tu btams te/ phyi nang gsang ba'i bar chad gang gis kyang mi tshugs shing*/ tshe srog rdo rje'i brag ltar brtan pa dang 'chi med ye shes kyi sku 'grub pa'i mos pa dang nges shes brtan po mdzad par zhu/ de nas shis brjod rgyas pas rab tu gnas par bya zhing*/ dkyil 'khor rjes kyi bya ba'i las rim thams cad spyi dang mthun par bya'o/ ༈ bka' rdzogs pa chen po yang zab dkon mchog spyi 'dus kyi dbang gi lo rgyus mtshams sbyor dmigs pa 'bogs tshul rnams sgrigs chags su bkod pa 'di ni/ gter ston chen po de nyid kyi sku'i dbon po sogs don gnyer mang por phan par dmigs nas/ sna tshogs rang grol gyi zin ris su bgyis pa 'dis kyang gzhan phan rgya cher 'grub par gyur cig dge'o/ 102)
